operation: Computer Use opened the exact locally packaged application, selected an external GOROOT through the native macOS directory chooser, applied it, ran a real Go test, restarted the IDE to verify persistence, restored Bundled / automatic, and exited normally.
observations: Settings > Go showed the bundled Go 1.26.10 SDK, Add local…, Download…, and separate gopls and Delve executable fields.
Add local… opened a native macOS dialog titled 'Select Go SDK Home (GOROOT)' with Finder navigation, search, New Folder, Cancel and Open controls.
Cancel returned to the unchanged Go settings page; no SDK was registered or selected in this check.
evidenceBoundary: The native run verifies local SDK directory selection, validation, registration, persistence, Run, layout and restoration. It does not claim that every external SDK version or remote/container SDK workflow is compatible.
processesAfterVerification: The exact local candidate process was subsequently closed only after this observation.

selectedSdk.selection: Add local… → native Select Go SDK Home (GOROOT) → Open → Apply → OK

persistence: After a normal IDE Exit and relaunch, Settings > Go still selected the external go1.26.10 GOROOT.

layoutDefectAndFix.observed: Before the layout fix, the long SDK model/details text widened the form beyond the Settings viewport and moved the combo arrow and right edge off-screen.
layoutDefectAndFix.fix: Cap the combo and detail preferred width at 520 while keeping zero minimum width and full text in the tooltip.
layoutDefectAndFix.nativeRecheck: The rebuilt macOS app showed the combo arrow, Add local, Download and Remove registration inside the visible Settings width.

restore: After persistence and run verification, bundled / automatic was selected again and the reopened Settings page showed the bundled SDK, leaving the test project at its original SDK policy.
remediation: Restored the test project to Bundled / automatic and exited the exact candidate application normally.
